related.description: 👷 [oh-my-zsh plugin] git clone and change directory by a single command
Zsh plugin to enhance git completion to include in the remotes completion (e.g. from `git clone`) any URL in the clipboard
This is a clone of the plugin "git" present at: https://github.com/robbyrussell/oh-my-zsh
:nut_and_bolt: An oh-my-zsh plugin for git clone && cd
Oh-my-zsh plugin for mono repository management
